name: Folderit — Email alerts for failed automation workflows

parameters.content:
# Shared failure alerts
For Tailor-plan Folderit automation operators. Connect an SMTP credential in Email the workflow owner. Set your real sender, recipient and HTTPS n8n instance origin in Settings. The sender must be permitted by your mail provider.

Save this workflow. In EACH main workflow, open **⋯ → Settings → Error workflow**, choose this workflow and save. Create a controlled failure in an ACTIVATED test workflow and check the actual recipient mailbox. Manual executions do not automatically invoke Error Trigger.

This workflow sends only names/IDs and a same-origin execution link. It omits raw errors, stack traces, document content, API tokens and signed storage links. Trigger failures may not have an execution ID. Monitor SMTP delivery separately; an alert workflow can itself fail.
